description: Client-side script for Calendar module in vtiger CRM, handling UI interactions, AJAX requests, event management, and form validation.

methods.name: DisableSharing
methods.description: Disables sharing for selected users in the calendar sharing list.

methods.name: showhide
methods.description: Toggles display of an HTML element between 'none' and 'block'.

methods.name: showhideRepeat
methods.description: Shows or hides repeat options UI based on checkbox state.

methods.name: gshow
methods.description: Displays a form or UI element and populates it with event data.

methods.name: rptoptDisp
methods.description: Displays repeat options UI based on selected recurrence pattern.

methods.name: Taskshow
methods.description: Shows task creation UI with pre-filled start date and time.

methods.name: ghide
methods.description: Hides a specified UI element.

methods.name: moveMe
methods.description: Calculates mouse position for drag-and-drop operations.

methods.name: switchClass
methods.description: Switches CSS class of a module element to indicate selection.

methods.name: enableCalstarttime
methods.description: Enables or disables start time input based on checkbox.

methods.name: check_form
methods.description: Validates calendar event form before submission.

methods.name: task_check_form
methods.description: Validates task form before submission.

methods.name: maintask_check_form
methods.description: Validates main task form before submission.

methods.name: userEventSharing
methods.description: Assigns shared users to an event.

methods.name: incUser
methods.description: Adds selected users from available list to assigned list.

methods.name: rmvUser
methods.description: Removes selected users from assigned list.

methods.name: removeActContacts
methods.description: Deletes contacts related to an activity in the calendar.

methods.name: formSelectColumnString
methods.description: Converts selected options into a semicolon-separated string.

methods.name: fnRedirect
methods.description: Redirects to list or hour view based on selection.

methods.name: fnAddEvent
methods.description: Displays event creation UI at mouse position with pre-filled data.

methods.name: fnRemoveEvent
methods.description: Hides the add event dropdown menu.

methods.name: fnShowEvent
methods.description: Shows the add event dropdown menu.

methods.name: getMiniCal
methods.description: Fetches and displays mini calendar via AJAX.

methods.name: getCalSettings
methods.description: Fetches and displays calendar settings via AJAX.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates status of an event or task via AJAX and refreshes view.

methods.name: cal_navigation
methods.description: Navigates calendar views (next, previous) via AJAX.

methods.name: getcalAction
methods.description: Displays context menu for calendar items and sets action links.

methods.name: dispLayer
methods.description: Displays a UI layer element.

methods.name: checkgroup
methods.description: Toggles between user and group owner selection.

methods.name: calendarChangeOwner
methods.description: Changes ownership of calendar activities via AJAX.

methods.name: delActivity
methods.description: Deletes an activity (event or task) via AJAX.

methods.name: cal_show
methods.description: Shows a specified UI element.

methods.name: fnAssignTo
methods.description: Shows assign-to options based on selected entity type.

methods.name: fnShowPopup
methods.description: Displays a popup layer.

methods.name: fnHidePopup
methods.description: Hides a popup layer.

methods.name: getValidationarr
methods.description: Fetches activity details and populates form for viewing/editing.

methods.name: setFieldvalues
methods.description: Populates form fields with activity data.

methods.name: toggleTaskAssignType
methods.description: Switches task assignment between user and group.

methods.name: dochange
methods.description: Copies start date/time to end date/time fields.

methods.name: getSelectedStatus
methods.description: Adjusts UI based on event status (Held, Not Held).

methods.name: changeEndtime_StartTime
methods.description: Adjusts end time based on start time.

methods.name: calDuedatetime
methods.description: Calculates and sets end/due date and time based on start date/time.

methods.name: cal_fnvshobj
methods.description: Displays a floating UI element near a target object.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds a contact option to a select element.

methods.name: getdispDate
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a string based on date format.
